name: Speed Auditor
author: JRMora

sections.description:
Speed Auditor helps WordPress site owners identify performance bottlenecks in real-time while browsing their site. It generates a downloadable technical report that pinpoints critical elements for Core Web Vitals and structural efficiency.

Main Features:
* Visual Performance Signal: Real-time color-coded icons (Green/Yellow/Red) in the Admin Bar based on LCP optimization status.
* Technical Knowledge Base: New guide under Tools > Speed Auditor to help users understand metrics like DOM depth, LCP, and Media Latency.
* Accurate LCP Identification: Detects the Largest Contentful Paint element and validates its optimization.
* Structural DOM Audit: Breakdown of nodes by zones (Header, Content, Footer) and maximum nesting depth analysis.
* Media Latency Monitor: Identifies the slowest loading images on the page by measuring real-time transfer duration.
* Dynamic Reporting: Generates a .txt report with a smart filename including the page slug and date for easy tracking.
* Privacy Focused: Works entirely in the browser using the Performance API. No data is saved to the database.
* Translation Ready: Fully compatible with WordPress internationalization (i18n) standards.

Update Notice

1.1.8

This version improves the technical report with actionable tips to help you move from an Orange/Red icon to a Green one by optimizing your LCP elements.

1.1.7

This update ensures audit accuracy by disabling reports and color alerts within the WordPress admin area.

1.1.6

This version introduces a new Technical Guide under Tools > Speed Auditor to help you understand your reports.

1.1.5

This version adds a real-time visual traffic light system to your Admin Bar.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the speed-auditor folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. You will see a new “Speed Auditor” link in your top admin bar (Admin only).
  4. Access the technical guide under Tools > Speed Auditor.
sections.changelog:
1.1.8

  • Improved: Technical report now includes detailed actionable tips to optimize LCP elements (Lazy load and Fetchpriority).
  • Improved: Better differentiation between Image and Text LCP elements in reports.

1.1.7

  • Fix: Restricted performance monitoring and report generation to the frontend only.
  • Improved: Admin Bar icon remains inactive in the dashboard to ensure audit accuracy.

1.1.6

  • New: Technical Guide page added to Tools > Speed Auditor with explanations for all audited metrics.
  • New: Media Latency threshold table added to the knowledge base.
  • Improved: Internalization (i18n) support for interface and reports.
  • Improved: Report footer now includes a direct link to the WordPress dashboard guide.
  • Fix: Renamed to Speed Auditor to comply with repository trademark policies.

1.1.5

  • New: Visual LCP status indicators (Green, Yellow, Red) in the Admin Bar.
  • New: Auto-detection of text-based LCP for instant “OK” status.
